name: bare-events

exports.name: EventEmitter
signatures:
interface EventEmitter<in out M extends EventMap = EventMap> {
  addListener<E extends keyof M, R>(name: E, fn: EventHandler<M[E], R>): this
  addOnceListener<E extends keyof M, R>(name: E, fn: EventHandler<M[E], R>): this
  prependListener<E extends keyof M, R>(name: E, fn: EventHandler<M[E], R>): this
  prependOnceListener<E extends keyof M, R>(name: E, fn: EventHandler<M[E], R>): this
  removeListener<E extends keyof M, R>(name: E, fn: EventHandler<M[E], R>): this
  removeAllListeners<E extends keyof M>(name?: E): this
  on<E extends keyof M, R>(name: E, fn: EventHandler<M[E], R>): this
  once<E extends keyof M, R>(name: E, fn: EventHandler<M[E], R>): this
  off<E extends keyof M, R>(name: E, fn: EventHandler<M[E], R>): this
  emit<E extends keyof M>(name: E, ...args: M[E]): boolean
  listeners<E extends keyof M, R>(name: E): EventHandler<M[E], R>
  rawListeners<E extends keyof M, R>(name: E): EventHandler<M[E], R>[]
  eventNames(): (keyof M)[]
  listenerCount<E extends keyof M>(name: E): number
  getMaxListeners(): number
  setMaxListeners(n: number): void
}
exports.description: An emitter of named events to which listener functions can be attached, closely mirroring Node.js's `EventEmitter`.

members.name: addListener
signatures: addListener<E extends keyof M, R>(name: E, fn: EventHandler<M[E], R>): this
members.description: Add `fn` as a listener for `name`, called on every subsequent emit. Returns `this` for chaining.

params.name: name
params.description: The event name to listen for.

params.name: fn
params.description: The listener function, called with the event's arguments on each emit.

members.name: addOnceListener
signatures: addOnceListener<E extends keyof M, R>(name: E, fn: EventHandler<M[E], R>): this
members.description: Add `fn` as a listener for `name` that is removed after it fires once. Returns `this` for chaining.

params.name: name
params.description: The event name to listen for.

params.name: fn
params.description: The listener function, called once with the event's arguments then removed.

members.name: emit
signatures: emit<E extends keyof M>(name: E, ...args: M[E]): boolean
members.description: Synchronously call each listener registered for `name`, in registration order, with `args`. Returns `true` if there were listeners, `false` otherwise. Emitting `'error'` with no `'error'` listeners throws the error asynchronously instead of calling any listener.

params.name: name
params.description: The event name to emit.

params.name: args
params.description: Arguments passed to each listener registered for `name`.

members.name: EventEmitter.defaultMaxListeners
members.description: The default max-listeners value used by `getMaxListeners()`.

members.name: EventEmitter.forward
signatures: EventEmitter.forward<F extends EventMap, E extends keyof F, T extends Pick<F, E>>(from: EventEmitter<F>, to: EventEmitter<T>, names: E | E[], opts?: { emit?: (name: E, ...args: T[E]) => void }): void
members.description: Forward events named in `names` from `from` to `to`, re-emitting them on `to` only while `to` has at least one listener for that event.

params.name: from
params.description: The emitter to forward events from.

params.name: to
params.description: The emitter to forward events to.

params.name: names
params.description: The event name, or array of event names, to forward.

params.name: opts
params.description: Options; `emit` overrides how forwarded events are re-emitted on `to` (defaults to `to.emit`).

exports.name: EventEmitterError
exports.description: The error class used for emitter-internal errors, such as an unhandled `'error'` event or an aborted `events.on`/`events.once` wait.

members.name: EventEmitterError.OPERATION_ABORTED
members.description: Create an `EventEmitterError` wrapping `cause`, used when an `AbortSignal` aborts a pending `events.on` or `events.once` wait.

params.name: cause
params.description: The abort reason wrapped by the error.

params.name: msg
params.description: An optional custom message for the wrapping error.

members.name: EventEmitterError.UNHANDLED_ERROR
members.description: Create an `EventEmitterError` wrapping `cause`, used when an `'error'` event is emitted with no listeners attached.

params.name: cause
params.description: The underlying error wrapped by the error.

params.name: msg
params.description: An optional custom message for the wrapping error.
